high_level_description: The image is a news article headline and accompanying photographs from a report about a bus accident in Mumbai. The headline reads: "Mumbai accident: Death toll climbs to seven, 43 injured in BEST bus crash." Below the headline, there is a description stating that the driver of the BEST bus on route number 332 lost control over the wheel and dashed into pedestrians as well as some vehicles. The photographs show the aftermath of the accident at night. In the first photo, a damaged car is visible with its front end crumpled and debris scattered around.
